name: Ontology Package
distinct_validation_purpose: Proves that one ontology package is a closed, source-bound, typed, locally retrievable Product output whose identity remains distinct from Product, Product Ontology, runtime, and source authority.

orthogonality_rules.statement: package_id, product_ref, product_output_ref, and source_binding are explicit independent fields and cannot be inferred from path or label.
An ontology package is a Product output instance, not the Product, Product Ontology, runtime, or source authority.
Human continuation is generated from canonical package bytes and creates no canonical axis.

four_facets.classification: Ontology Package is an Artifact Type/v2 candidate whose semantic, authority, lifecycle, Product-output, and source-binding identities remain explicit.
four_facets.schema: schema.json is a self-contained closed Draft 2020-12 instance contract for ontology-package.json.
four_facets.human_continuation: ONTOLOGY-PACKAGE.md and ARTIFACT.md are deterministic generated projections that add no canonical fields.
four_facets.machine_checkable: Schema closure, exact semantic bindings, source binding, identity non-collapse, hostile rejection, witness parity, and projection parity are executable.

required_checks: hostile authority, missing binding, and unknown-field rejection

typed_residue.missing: Lab has no admitted local Ontology Definition; CAV2-D19 remains an exact active external semantic binding.
typed_residue.consequence: Ontology Package/v1 cannot be admitted until the definition owner resolves the local semantic binding.

typed_residue.missing: No artifact-type-owner decision admits Ontology Package/v1.
typed_residue.consequence: PASS remains candidate schema-and-contract evidence only.

claim_ceiling: This package is an Ontology Package/v1 Artifact Type candidate. PASS proves only its exact schema-and-artifact-type contract and fixtures; it does not admit the type or any instance, approve the Product, adopt a runtime, or authorize publication, release, deployment, or source retirement.
